استنشقن (form X)
# اِسْتَنْشَقْنَ (istanšaqna) /is.tan.ʃaq.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَنْشَقَ (istanšaqa)
# اُسْتُنْشِقْنَ (ustunšiqna) /us.tun.ʃiq.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَنْشَقَ (istanšaqa)
# اِسْتَنْشِقْنَ (istanšiqna) /is.tan.ʃiq.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَنْشَقَ (istanšaqa)
